One core for all languages: rooms, objects, rules and solution stay the same, languages change only texts and words. Every built game has a single language, chosen in the Play and Build tabs.
The language you write the core in
It decides the game's default responses and the word for restarting. The responses you have not changed switch to the new language; your own texts stay as they are.
For now the program knows Italian and English; more languages will come later.

The words the player types in

, separated by commas: one word each, the first is the main one (shown on the quick buttons). Phrasal verbs already work by writing only the verb: in "pick up lamp" "up" is a direction and in "look at door" "at" joins, and the game skips them.
The name the player uses for the object: a single word. Labels and descriptions are translated in the Objects section above.
the texts and words of a text adventure (a game where you type commands such as "take key").
Fill in only the fields "traduzione", "parole", "etichetta", "nome", "sinonimi" and "aggettivi". Do not change "chiave", "contesto", "originale" or the other fields.
Reply with this same JSON, complete and valid, with no comments and no other text before or after.
Keep the tone, the person (usually the second: "you") and the tense of the original. Keep placeholders such as {0} and line breaks exactly.
contesto says where the text appears. Object labels have the indefinite article and end up in a list ("You can see: a key and a table.").
If there is "traduzione_precedente", the original has changed: update that translation. If "traduzione" is already filled in, check it and fix it only if needed.

Commands, directions, prepositions, ignored words, names, synonyms and adjectives are words the player types: one word each, lowercase, with no spaces or apostrophes, at most 15 letters. The first word of a command or a direction is the main one; add common synonyms and abbreviations.
For phrasal verbs (in English "pick up", "look at") write only the verb: the particle is already a direction or a preposition and the game skips it.
nome is the object's main name (a noun); "aggettivi" tell apart objects with the same name. The "etichetta" of a direction is how it is written in the list of exits.
On vintage computers (Commodore 64, ZX Spectrum) the only accented letters available are à è é ì ò ù and their capitals: avoid other special symbols.
